faq.q: How much does a New Year's Eve yacht charter in Marbella cost?
faq.a: Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), which include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for 4 hours and include a free jet ski. For larger yachts (Ferretti 94, Canados 86), pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What boats are available for NYE 2030 charters?
faq.a: Our fleet includes 17 boats departing from Puerto Banús, from the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax). Popular choices for groups are the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) and Mangusta 80 (12 pax). All boats include a licensed skipper and full amenities.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. Just bring your party spirit.

faq.q: Where do the boats depart from?
faq.a: All boats depart from Puerto Banús, the famous marina on the Golden Mile. You'll meet your skipper at the dock, board, and head out to sea for the best view of the fireworks. Return to the same marina after the cruise.

faq.q: Can we see the fireworks from the boat?
faq.a: Yes — the main fireworks display over Puerto Banús is clearly visible from the water. Your skipper will position the boat for an unobstructed view. You'll also see fireworks from Marbella Marina and other coastal spots along the bay.

faq.q: How many guests can we bring?
faq.a: Maximum capacity varies by boat: 12 guests on most large yachts (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94), 10 on the Lagoon 380 and Pershing 46, 6 on the Speedboat and Red Tide, and 5 on the Dubhe and Mariah SX21. Choose according to your group size.

faq.q: Should we book early for NYE 2030?
faq.a: Absolutely. New Year's Eve is the most popular night for yacht charters in Marbella. Boats book out weeks — sometimes months — in advance. We recommend reserving as soon as you have your group confirmed to secure your preferred vessel and time slot.

Contact us via WhatsApp for the fastest response. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can book directly through our website. For larger yachts (Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Maiora 26m), we'll provide a tailored quote. A deposit secures your booking.

data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2030 in Marbella — imagine watching the midnight fireworks from the deck of your private yacht, champagne in hand, with the Mediterranean stretching around you. A Boat Rental Marbella charter from Puerto Banús gives you the best seat in the house: on the water, away from the crowds, with your own crew and a stocked bar. Prices start at €749 for two hours on boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and include everything except your party playlist.

Why a yacht charter is the best way to see NYE fireworks in Marbella

Marbella's New Year's Eve fireworks are launched from Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina, and the shoreline gets packed early. From a boat, you get an unobstructed view of the full display — the bursts reflect off the water, and you can anchor at the perfect angle. Plus, you control the music, the drinks, and the company. No queuing for taxis, no crowded bars. Your skipper handles the navigation; you handle the celebration.

Our fleet for NYE 2030 charters

We offer 17 boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. For small groups (up to 5), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are cosy and affordable. For up to 10 guests, the Pershing 46 (14m) or Lagoon 380 (11.6m) are excellent. For the full party experience with up to 12 guests, choose the Mangusta 80 (24m), Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m), or Ferretti 94 (29m). Each boat includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. See the full Boat Rental Marbella fleet for specifications.

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden extras. For Tier B, the 4-hour minimum includes a free jet ski — perfect for a pre-fireworks spin around the bay.

What's included in every NYE charter

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You're welcome to bring your own food or decorations. Many groups bring party hats, banners, and a speaker for music. Just keep it safe and respectful of the boat.

Itinerary ideas for your NYE 2030 cruise

Most charters depart from Puerto Banús around 22:00, cruise along the Marbella coastline past the Golden Mile, and anchor near the marina for the midnight fireworks. After the display, you can cruise back to port or extend the party at sea. For longer charters (8 hours), you can include a sunset cruise to Cabopino or Estepona, then return for the fireworks. Your skipper will suggest the best route based on weather and crowd conditions.

How to book your NYE 2030 yacht charter

Reserve early — New Year's Eve in Marbella is the busiest night of the year. For Tier A and Tier B boats, you can book directly through our website. For larger yachts (Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Maiora 26m, K80), contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. A deposit secures your slot; balance is due 7 days before departure. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance for the best choice of boats and time slots.
